title: FY26 Pipeline Dredging MATOC
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION SOUTHWESTERN.ENDIST GALVESTON.W076 ENDIST GALVESTON
description_text: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Galveston District Office requires an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (MATOC) for Pipeline Dredging in multiple locations within the boundaries of the Galveston District.
